title: Bespoke Post Alternatives: 6 Boxes Like Bespoke Post - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Bespoke Post alternative? Compare six gear subscriptions by price and fit, from themed accessories and EDC to cocktail kits and grooming.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to Bespoke Post?


SprezzaBox. It sends a monthly themed box of four to six accessories, such as ties, socks, wallets, watches, and sunglasses, for $28 a month. The difference is the brands: the pieces come from SprezzaBox’s own sourcing rather than a shop of named labels.


Which one costs less than Bespoke Post?


SprezzaBox at $28 a month and the Men’s Luxury Soap Box at $15 a delivery both cost well under Bespoke Post’s $59 standard tier. The soap box sends a single bar, so it works as an add-on rather than a full replacement.


Do any of these ship outside the US?


Bespoke Post ships within the US only. SprezzaBox and the Men’s Luxury Soap Box also ship to Canada, the UK, Australia, and Switzerland, and The Maéstro Experience ships from Canada.


Is there a box just for menswear accessories?


Yes. Put This On’s[Gentlemen’s Association](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/gentlemens-association-putthison) sends a pocket square handmade in Los Angeles every other month, for $60 per shipment or less on a prepay plan.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


Yes. Each Cratejoy box here can be bought as a one-time gift from its listing page, and gift orders don’t renew. Check the listing’s estimated ship date before you plan around a birthday.
